x-sections.title: General
x-sections.description: The width, indentation, and newlines of the file.

x-sections.title: Line breaks
x-sections.description: Where lines break before the locals of a function, the fields of a struct, and constant expressions, and where closing parentheses go.

x-sections.title: Locals and fields
x-sections.description: How the locals of a function and the fields of a struct are separated.

x-sections.title: Comments
x-sections.description: The spacing of comments and the comment that keeps code from being formatted.

lineWidth.description: The width of a line the formatter will try to stay under. Note that this limit will be exceeded in some cases.

useTabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs instead of spaces.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces for an indent. With tabs, this is the width of a tab when deciding where to wrap lines.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
Uses carriage return, line feed.
Uses line feed.

splitClosingParens.description: Whether to put the closing parentheses of a multi-line list on their own line.

wrapBeforeLocals.description: When to put a line break before the locals of a function.

oneOf.description: Never.
When they don't fit on the line.
When there's more than one.
Always.

wrapBeforeFields.description: When to put a line break before the fields of a struct.

oneOf.description: Never.
When they don't fit on the line.
When there's more than one.
Always.

wrapBeforeConstExpr.description: When to put a line break before a constant expression.

oneOf.description: Never.
When it doesn't fit on the line.
When there's more than one instruction.
Always.

multiLineLocals.description: How to separate the locals of a function.

oneOf.description: Keeps them on one line.
Puts them on separate lines when they don't fit on one.
Puts them on separate lines when they don't fit on one or when the first one is followed by a line break.
Fills each line with as many as fit.
Puts each on its own line.

multiLineFields.description: How to separate the fields of a struct.

oneOf.description: Keeps them on one line.
Puts them on separate lines when they don't fit on one.
Puts them on separate lines when they don't fit on one or when the first one is followed by a line break.
Fills each line with as many as fit.
Puts each on its own line.

formatComments.description: Whether to add a space at the start and end of comments. Comments that already have whitespace there are left as they are either way.

ignoreCommentDirective.description: The text of a line comment that keeps the module or module field after it from being formatted.
